finalText:
Done. Both issues from the bump are fixed.

The first was in `src/core/options.js` — the new bundler passes `retryCount` but the code was reading `retries`, so that threw. Changed it to use the right field name.

The second was in `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, and the strict check would crash. Simplified it to just check if the flag is `true`, treating `undefined` and `false` the same way.

Build now finishes clean: zero errors, 8 warnings (all from old deprecations in the bumped packages, not your code).
